items.mainDefect: Moving legacy writes into goroutines removes the guarantee that legacy storage has been updated before the API returns.

secondary.defect: Legacy goroutines inherit the request context, so returning from the handler can cancel the pending legacy writes.
Legacy write errors are recorded only in metrics and are no longer logged.

items.mainDefect: Legacy goroutines inherit the request context, allowing request completion to cancel the pending legacy writes.

secondary.defect: Legacy write errors are no longer logged, leaving failures visible only in metrics.

items.mainDefect: The Delete, Update, and DeleteCollection tests lack legacy expectations and therefore do not verify the dual writes.

secondary.defect: The tests do not synchronize with legacy goroutines, making unexpected mock-call panics depend on scheduling.
